🇲🇽🏫 <u>Teachers Get the Vote on USICAMM</u>

Mexico's Education Ministry has called a national consultation of teachers on October 30 to replace USICAMM, the system that controls teacher hiring, promotions and incentives. It fills the whole second School Technical Council session of the year, with online voting open through November 1. ANUIES will send 2,200 university professors to observe in 1,105 schools. Results come out November 5 and will be the basis of the reform the government presents in November, fulfilling Sheinbaum's Commitment 27.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>The INE's Favorite Supplier Didn't Start With Taddei</u>

The companies tied to José Alfredo Hernández Casillas, the electoral-materials supplier at the center of the audit that brought down INE chief Guadalupe Taddei, were winning contracts long before she arrived in 2023. La Jornada counts at least 49 contracts from the INE and state electoral bodies between 2018 and 2025, worth 1.45 billion pesos, for ballot boxes, ballots and voting booths. It started under Peña Nieto, with Lorenzo Córdova running the INE. One firm alone, Cajas Graf, took about 656.6 million pesos. The ASF found simulated agreements, triangulated funds, conflicts of interest and dealings with shell companies.

🇲🇽🇨🇺 "If there were no Cuban doctors in many of the hospitals, much of the Mexican population could not be cared for." "They have fair contracts, the same as Mexicans. It is not true that a Cuban doctor is paid more than a Mexican doctor. They earn the same, and they are hired directly." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Oct 26, 2026 A reporter asked whether Mexico has enough specialists to replicate a hospital model in all 32 states. Sheinbaum showed residency admissions. In 2011, under Calderón, only about 6,000 general doctors entered specialty training; many were rejected "because they always thought private health care was better." Under Peña Nieto it rose to 8,330 and 8,124. Since 2021 it has more than doubled, and the first of those cohorts have already graduated. Next step: more teaching hospitals.

🔥🇲🇽 "The right represents the great economic powers. The right represents authoritarianism. The right represents the defense of corruption and privileges. That is the right." "And we humanist governments represent the people and the defense of their rights, and of democracy, and of justice." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Oct 26, 2026 A reporter asked about Meta being accused of favoring Bolsonaro on election day in Brazil, and whether Mexico should audit social media algorithms. Sheinbaum's answer: inform people how international right-wing networks operate; the electoral institute must review the platforms' conduct; the law already bars foreign interference in elections. "Only the people can save the people, and only the organized people can save the nation." She closed on Lula's win: "The people organized and united will never be defeated."
